text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...!
As expected of a trending amusement park, it is quite lively, desu wa.
Shall we head in right away as well?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, tsk, tsk, don't rush, McQueen!
Efficiency is life when conquering an amusement park, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Follow my "Flawless Schedule" today and enjoy the ride~♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
――Yaaaay! The ab-so-lute best~~!
――Kyaaaaah! W-We're falling~~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Look at this photo,
your face while we were dropping, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, would you please stop laughing so much, desu wa?
It cannot be helped, as I am not used to such things.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then, just like charging into the 4th corner,
let's give it everything we've got, here we gooo~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Teio-san, spinning the teacup that much will――kyaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Honestly...! If that is how you want to play it...
Take this in return, desu wa! Eiiii!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, not bad, McQueen!
Come on, spin it even faster, faster!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then~, next up on the "Flawless Schedule"
is the limited-time Ultimate Shooting gallery!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You shoot cork guns while dodging attacks.
Hit the moving targets and you win prizes, apparently♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Um, Teio-san.
May we take a brief rest, perhaps...?
It seems... I let myself get a bit too carried away, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~n, I figured you'd say that around now,
so I planned for you to take a break right from the start!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just sit back and watch me in action.
I told you, didn't I? It's a "Flawless Schedule"!
(Pew, pew, pew――!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That makes 3 consecutive hits!!
Alright~, still going strong~!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Guh, you're good!
If that's the case, let's add even more prizes and targets all at once~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun~, for the invincible Teio-sama,
something like that will be over in a――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? That target's angle is kind of... Gaaah, you little...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Jeez~~!!
Why won't that one target get hit?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Truly impregnable...
However, isn't this already plenty?
You have obtained so many prizes already――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way!
I'm nev~er giving up until I hit that target!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Teio-san,
you are acting just like a little child, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because if it's not what I really want,
there's no point in winning it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I got a lot of prizes. But that's no reason
to give up on the thing I actually want.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What's the meaning in things that are easy to get?
Only the hardest one, the most sparkling one――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Only the coolest thing is worthy of me!
You think so too, right McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Worthy of oneself, is it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, when it comes to you,
I cannot tell if you are arrogant or completely earnest, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well, desu wa. Allow me to assist you.
I shall call out whenever the targets move,
so please focus entirely on your timing—

One day, I spotted Tokai Teio and Mejiro McQueen
on their way back from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aah, that was so much fun!
We managed to snag the prizes too, total success!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. Teio-san,
thank you so much for inviting me today.
Allow me to express my gratitude once again, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...What's this?
You're being awfully honest today, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing... I was merely reminded
of the time when you first invited me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Kh... as I thought, my acceleration is still lacking, desu wa.
Should I surrender this path and seek another approach...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, McQueen!
So about next weekend, wanna go to the amusement park with me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you truly believe something is worthy of you,
you never give up until it is yours...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Taking a leaf from your book, Teio-san,
I shall devote myself even further starting tomorrow, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
? I don't really get it,
but if you're all fired up, I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After all, for the invincible me,
nothing suits me better than 1st place!
